verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Lorikeet's MCP server, simulations, coaching, and quality-assurance tooling, but contains no mention of customer-facing channel coverage such as chat, email, in-app, Slack, WhatsApp, or social messaging for end customers — the one Slack reference is about internal Coach access, not a customer channel. Missing for 10: evidence of multichannel deployment (chat widget, email inbox, in-app SDK, WhatsApp, Slack-as-customer-channel, social/DM integrations).
